description: This file defines the HistoryItemViewModel class, a ViewModel component for a calculator application's history item, including properties for expression and result strings, and methods to access tokens and commands.

classes.name: HistoryItemViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class representing a calculator history item, exposing properties for expression and result, and internal methods to access tokens and commands.

methods.name: HistoryItemViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewModel with expression, result, tokens, and commands.

methods.name: GetTokens
methods.description: Returns the shared pointer to the vector of token pairs.

methods.description: Returns the shared pointer to the vector of expression commands.
